'''Boreleo''' was the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Exodo II]]. By [[44 ABY]] it was a abandoned [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony and at the same year destroyed during an [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Battle over Exodo II|mutiny]].
